description: The same OpenAI chat completion, streamed with usage, auto-instrumented by Laminar.
notes: lmnr 0.8.8. LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY is capture-project-key. LMNR_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on the span. LMNR_RELEASE is capture, and initialize also passes release capture, so the git commit is not read. The default export is gRPC with gzip. force_http sends OTLP HTTP to the receiver origin on its port, path /v1/traces. The HTTP exporter hardcodes gzip, which the receiver rejects, so the scenario forces identity compression on the HTTP trace and log exporters before initialize. disable_batch is true. instruments is only OpenAI. The client sets stream_options.include_usage. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the answer into 4 chunks. The span has no timing attribute. It sets OTLP status OK and emits seven llm.content.completion.chunk events with no attributes. Token counts are copied: input 24, output 12, cache_read 8, reasoning 3, total 36. gen_ai.request.base_url is the public host https://api.openai.com/v1/. llm.headers is the string None. ThreadingInstrumentor is always enabled and emitted no spans. There is no separate anonymous-telemetry switch in 0.8.8.

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
